name: skillhook
description: Turn this machine into a permanent, secure webhook endpoint that runs Agent Skills with Claude Code or Codex. Two skills teach the agent to install and expose skillhook and to write good webhook skills; the bundled MCP server manages skills, secrets, jobs and exposure.

interface.shortDescription: Webhook in, agent out — on your own machine
interface.longDescription: skillhook turns a Mac or Linux machine into a permanent, secure webhook endpoint that runs Agent Skills with Claude Code or Codex, using the login you already have. Granola, Sentry, GitHub, Stripe, Slack or a plain curl call POST to https://<your-node>.ts.net/hooks/<skill>; skillhook verifies the signature, queues a job and runs the skill's SKILL.md unattended. This plugin adds two skills — installing and exposing skillhook, and writing good webhook skills — plus the skillhook MCP server for status, skills, secrets, jobs, Tailscale exposure and signed test webhooks.
defaultPrompt: Set up skillhook on this machine and give me a public webhook URL for the hello skill.
Write a skillhook skill that opens a pull request when Sentry reports a new issue in ~/dev/api.
My Granola webhook gets a 503 from skillhook — what is wrong?
